<h1>状态</h1>
<div id="contentSub">
<a href="/wiki/%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7:%E9%80%8F%E6%98%8Ede%E6%B3%AA%E5%85%89" title="用户:透明de泪光">透明de泪光</a>&nbsp于1个月前<a href="/wiki/%E7%89%B9%E6%AE%8A:%E7%BC%96%E8%BE%91%E5%B7%AE%E5%BC%82/24530" class="mw-ui-anchor mw-ui-progressive mw-ui-quiet" title="特殊:编辑差异/24530" rel="nofollow">修改了</a>此页面。

<section id="bodyContent" class="body">
<div id="mw-content-text" class="mw-body-content mw-content-ltr" lang="zh-Hans" dir="ltr"><div class="mw-parser-output"><p><b>状态</b>是<b>持续效果</b>的核心载体。在战斗中，状态可由<a href="/wiki/%E6%80%AA%E7%89%A9" title="怪物">怪物</a>、<a href="/wiki/%E8%8D%AF%E6%B0%B4" title="药水">药水</a>、<a href="/wiki/%E9%81%97%E7%89%A9" title="遗物">遗物</a>或<a href="/wiki/%E5%8D%A1%E7%89%8C" title="卡牌">卡牌</a>施加于角色，并产生各类独特效果。
</p>

<h2><span id=".E6.98.BE.E7.A4.BA"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="显示">显示</span></h2>
<p>状态以小图标的形式显示在角色或怪物生命值的下方。有的状态会通过角标数值指示其数值。
</p>
<h2><span id=".E6.95.B0.E5.80.BC"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="数值">数值</span></h2>
<p>状态的数值常以点数或层数计算，通常代表效果强度（如<span class="huiji-tt" style="display:inline-block;margin:0 0.25em;"><span style="display:inline-block;transform:translateY(-0.1em);user-select:none;"><img alt="Strength <h2><span id=".E5.88.86.E7.B1.BB"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="分类">分类</span></h2>
<p>根据实际作用，状态可分为<b>负面状态</b>与<b>其他状态</b>。
</p><p><b>负面状态</b>可被<span class="huiji-tt" style="display:inline-block;margin:0 0.25em;"><span style="display:inline-block;transform:translateY(-0.1em);user-select:none;"><img alt="Artifact power.png" src="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/24px-Artifact_power.png" decoding="async" width="24" height="24" srcset="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/36px-Artifact_power.png 1.5x, https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/48px-Artifact_power.png 2x" data-file-width="256" data-file-height="256" /></span><a href="/wiki/%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E5%88%B6%E5%93%81" title="人工制品"><span style="color:#FFC040;">人工制品</span></a><span class="huiji-tt-preload" style="display:none;"><span style="display:block;min-width:260px;max-width:360px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(40,52,60,0.96);border:1px solid #6d8391;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(140,165,176,0.18) inset"><span style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;"><span style="flex:none;"><img alt="Artifact power.png" src="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/40px-Artifact_power.png" decoding="async" width="40" height="40" srcset="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/60px-Artifact_power.png 1.5x, https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/5/55/Artifact_power.png/80px-Artifact_power.png 2x" data-file-width="256" data-file-height="256" /></span><span style="flex:1;line-height:1.35;"><span style="display:block;color:#efc851;text-shadow:3px 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);">人工制品</span><span style="display:block;color:#fff6e2;text-shadow:3px 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);margin-top:2px;"><span class="color-gold">免疫</span>负面效果。</span></span></span></span></span></span>抵消。
</p>
<h2><span id=".E6.9C.BA.E5.88.B6"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="机制">机制</span></h2>
<h3><span id=".E7.BB.93.E7.AE.97.E9.A1.BA.E5.BA.8F"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="结算顺序">结算顺序</span></h3>
<p>当同一时机（例如“玩家回合开始时”）要触发多个状态效果时，将根据其在战斗中被施加的先后顺序来决定处理触发顺序，越早获得的状态越先触发。
</p><p>状态叠加时，施加时间以更早的为准。
</p><p>在状态栏中，多个状态效果根据其在战斗中被施加的先后顺序从左至右，从上至下依次排列。
</p>

</p>

<ul><li>一般地，具有多个参数的状态只有其中一个是可被叠加的状态层数。例如N个<span class="huiji-tt" style="display:inline-block;margin:0 0.25em;"><span style="display:inline-block;transform:translateY(-0.1em);user-select:none;"><img alt="Echo form power.png" src="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/24px-Echo_form_power.png" decoding="async" width="24" height="24" srcset="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/36px-Echo_form_power.png 1.5x, https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/48px-Echo_form_power.png 2x" data-file-width="256" data-file-height="256" /></span><a href="/wiki/%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81" title="回响形态"><span style="color:#FFC040;">回响形态</span></a><span class="huiji-tt-preload" style="display:none;"><span style="display:block;min-width:260px;max-width:360px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(40,52,60,0.96);border:1px solid #6d8391;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(140,165,176,0.18) inset"><span style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;"><span style="flex:none;"><img alt="Echo form power.png" src="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/40px-Echo_form_power.png" decoding="async" width="40" height="40" srcset="https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/60px-Echo_form_power.png 1.5x, https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/sts2/uploads/thumb/0/0a/Echo_form_power.png/80px-Echo_form_power.png 2x" data-file-width="256" data-file-height="256" /></span><span style="flex:1;line-height:1.35;"><span style="display:block;color:#efc851;text-shadow:3px 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);">回响形态</span><span style="display:block;color:#fff6e2;text-shadow:3px 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);margin-top:2px;">你每回合打出的第一张牌会多打出一次。</span></span></span></span></span></span>叠加，产生的效果是“每回合打出的前N张牌会被打出两次”而不是“每回合打出的第一张牌会被打出N+1次”<span class="heimu">当然更不是“每回合打出的前N张牌会被打出N+1次”，你在想什么呢！</span>。</li></ul></li>
